marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF809D1 Atomic Compact Series Cordless Compact Impact Driver Kit features a 20 V, 2 Ah battery and a variable speed trigger for precise control. With a torque rating of 1700 in-lb and 3200 impacts per minute, this kit is suitable for a variety of applications. The compact design and integrated LED light make it easy to use in tight spaces.
